Use case: identity-preserve. Production 2D game sprite INBETWEEN.
The reference contains A BEFORE on the left and B AFTER on the right. These are adjacent approved drawings of ONE character, not two characters. Draw exactly ONE whole-character pose that is precisely halfway in motion between A and B. Output a single isolated character on a true transparent background, no labels, no text, no ground or shadow.
CRITICAL invariants: match the reference's exact pear-shaped yellow plush body, original fixed camera, right-facing side angle, head/face/mouth dimensions, closed eyes, broad smile, ivory belly, brown mitten hands and dark soles, teal hip pouch. Same scale/proportions within character; do not redesign, make more realistic, simplify texture, change expression or add details. Copy head and torso as closely as possible from A; only limb positions change toward B. Do NOT blend two silhouettes; produce one clean drawing.
Motion constraint: The near support foot stays planted beneath the body; the far knee moves forward from the tucked-behind position toward the raised-forward position. Near fist is halfway between waist and chest.
Keep one continuous smooth back contour. The far arm is anatomically on the far side of the chest and occluded by torso; no extra shoulder, limb or ridge projecting from the back. Exactly two arms and two legs with correct front/back overlap. Pouch remains attached in the same rear-hip location.
Match the references' golden yellow and ivory, subtle fine fabric pattern and lighting; no tint, orange cast, new specular highlights or exposure change. Large clear centered sprite with 12% transparent padding around every extremity. Full body visible, feet uncut. ONE pose only, not a sheet, not a duplicated before/after.
